summary: Frontend-only testing of Ghost Maze MVP (Expo/React Native web preview). All 13 specified test cases PASSED. Main menu renders correctly (GHOST MAZE title, 4 ghost previews, Pellet Guy, START GAME, How To Play). Navigation to /game works. Game HUD shows LEVEL 1, SCORE 0, CATCHES 0/3, 3 LIVES dots. Pellets bar shows 127/127 initially. Maze board renders (testID 'maze-board' confirmed). All 4 ghost D-pads + 16 directional buttons + 4 select labels render correctly. Game loop runs - score climbed 0->130->260->510 over ~15s while pellets decreased 127->114->101->76, demonstrating continuous gameplay with no crashes. PAUSE button toggles to RESUME and back. QUIT returns to main menu. Selected ghost border highlights correctly (red for Blinky/dpad-0). No red-screen errors observed. No deprecated Expo packages detected in tested files. Mobile viewport 414x896.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: useEffect on level transitions (game.tsx L168-177) depends on advanceLevel/retryLevel which may cause stale closures if not memoized via useCallback in useGhostMaze hook - not observed as a defect but worth verifying.

Minor: pointerEvents='box-none' is passed as a style prop on the overlay View (game.tsx L251); the modern React Native convention is to use the pointerEvents prop directly on View. Not a functional issue in web preview.
seed_data_creation: None - purely client-side game, no backend integration
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ghost Maze is a client-side React Native/Expo game with no backend. Use mobile viewport 414x896. There is a 1.5s 'LEVEL 1' READY overlay (testID overlay-message) before gameplay starts. The game loop is requestAnimationFrame-based so score/pellets update continuously. All key UI elements have testID props (main-menu, play-btn, game-screen, game-hud, hud-level, hud-score, hud-catches, pellets-bar, pellets-text, maze-board, ghost-dpad-{0..3}, ghost-{0..3}-{up|down|left|right}, ghost-select-{0..3}, pause-btn, quit-btn, overlay-message, restart-btn, menu-btn).
